door_gpu.skip_reason: Two fused-on-CPU combinations are intentionally unsupported; CUDA recovery and CPU/CUDA normalizer checks pass.
door_gpu.source_integrity: All ndm_gym source and the four GPU-tested test files are byte-identical to the independently validated GPU snapshot.

compiler_repair: Missing Python development headers were supplied via CPATH from a data-disk extraction of Ubuntu libpython3.12-dev 3.12.3-1ubuntu0.17. Both original compiled HOI tests passed unchanged, separately and in the full suite. System Python and training environment were not upgraded.
coverage: CPU full and fast suites pass; skipped tests are not passes. This does not certify all upstream GPU kernels: known unmodified Triton configurations require 111104-123392 bytes/block while L40S supports 101376. Door uses native CPU physics and standard Torch GPU learning; its GPU component checks and separate exact-capacity training/recovery evidence have independent coverage.
submission_scope: Five machine-specific operational files are retained outside the contribution. Their 18 passing tests are excluded from these final submission totals. No task test was removed or weakened.
